descriptions.read_csv_records: Read quoted CSV in file order, with caller-chosen header handling.
descriptions.read_json_records: Read a list of objects, projecting caller-selected scalar fields in order.
descriptions.filter_records: Keep complete rows after a typed field-to-value or field-to-field comparison.
descriptions.order_records: Stable multi-column ordering of complete rows, with numeric/text keys and per-key directions.
descriptions.report_fields: Render chosen fields or original positions as tab-separated strings.
descriptions.derive_integer: Append checked integer arithmetic using a chosen field or constant.
descriptions.previous_field: Carry the previous value within a key tuple, including an explicit presence flag.
descriptions.running_total: Append an inclusive checked signed total, globally or per key.
descriptions.rank_records: Number rows within key tuples under stable caller ordering.
descriptions.reachable_nodes: Return distinct forward or reverse reachable nodes from one seed, excluding the seed.
descriptions.sqlite_records: Read multiple SQLite fields together in an explicit order from a read-only database.
descriptions.xml_records: Read correlated XML elements and attributes with caller-chosen XPath selectors.
descriptions.zip_file_records: Read regular ZIP entries in archive order, keeping selected metadata or exact payload bytes together.
descriptions.tree_file_records: Read regular files below a root with metadata or exact payload bytes, ordered by path. Skip symlinks.
descriptions.uri_records: Preserve original URI-list entries and project parsed scheme, host or fragment information.
descriptions.annotate_group_measure: Attach a group minimum, maximum, lower median or conditional count to every original row.
descriptions.match_intervals: Find overlapping, touching or strictly containing interval pairs within each key.
descriptions.filter_membership: Keep or exclude rows by membership in a literal set or the values of another column.
descriptions.first_matching_field: Carry the first matching field from a whole group or from rows strictly preceding the current one.
descriptions.interval_endpoints: Expand intervals into ordered signed endpoint events, processing departures before arrivals at the same minute.
descriptions.conditional_field: Append a value chosen by a typed comparison. Either branch can take a field or a literal.
descriptions.field_text_length: Append the length of a UTF-8 field in Unicode code points.
descriptions.graph_witnesses: Emit source, first hop, destination and a direct-edge flag for fixed-length walks or positive transitive closure.

sources.uri_records: Arch uriparser, URI parser, plus catalog GLib list reader
